ValidationRule.description: QAC - if reasons is others, Request Reason Others field is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name == 'Service Request' , ISPICKVAL(Reason_for_Waiver__c, 'Other'), OR( ISBLANK( Request_Reason_Others__c ), ISNULL(Request_Reason_Others__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Request Reason Others' field is mandatory when reason is ‘Others’.
